attributes.action: More support & education on Women’s Health
attributes.additional_details: I am living with both endometriosis and adenomyosis and experience debilitating pain that affects every aspect of my daily life. Despite seeking medical help, I do not feel I have received the support, understanding or further treatment I need. The physical and emotional toll has left me at the end of my tether. My experience highlights the urgent need for better awareness, faster diagnosis, improved access to care and greater support for those living with these conditions.
attributes.background: I call on the Government to improve support, diagnosis, treatment and education for endometriosis and adenomyosis. Greater awareness, better healthcare training, faster diagnosis pathways and increased research funding are needed to improve outcomes and quality of life for affected women.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for a similar action: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/765058

In addition, health is a devolved matter that the Welsh Government and Welsh Parliament is responsible for.

The Welsh Parliament has its own Petitions Committee. If you'd like to send your petition to the Welsh Parliament, you can find out more here: https://petitions.senedd.wales/
